front.anatomy: One entire FAR-SIDE FRONT LEG, from the rounded shoulder cap at the top through upper arm, elbow, forearm, wrist and the complete small ivory paw at the bottom. Slender front-leg anatomy, not a hind thigh. The slight elbow bend and paw position follow image 1 exactly.

hind.anatomy: One entire FAR-SIDE HIND LEG, beginning with a broad rounded hip-root and thigh at the top, a forward-left knee, a backward-right hock bend, then the full metatarsus and ivory paw pointing left. Keep the knee-to-hock zigzag indicated in image 1. Not a front leg, not a short shin, and not a single sausage-shaped limb. The thigh is broad because it normally hides under the kitten body.
